title: Speaking — Getting around
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on getting around.

questions: What part of your work or study do you look forward to?
When do you usually find it easiest to focus?
What would make your workplace or classroom more comfortable?
Do you expect to do something different in future?
How do you usually get around your area?
When was the last time you took an unfamiliar route?

part2.topic: Describe a journey when you found a better way to get somewhere.
points: how you discovered the new route
part2.closing: and explain whether you would take the same route again.

questions: What makes public transport attractive to people who own a car?
Which parts of a city benefit most from better pedestrian routes?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to getting around?
